name: Fountain
overview: The Bible uses the image of a fountain to illustrate both the source of divine life and grace as well as the consequences of forsaking God. Psalms 36:9 reveals God as the fountain of life, illuminating true understanding, while Jeremiah 2:13 contrasts this by depicting those who abandon God as turning to broken cisterns that cannot hold water. The fountain also symbolizes salvation and cleansing, as seen in Zechariah 13:1 where a fountain is opened for sin and uncleanness, and in Revelation 7:17 where the Lamb leads believers to living fountains of waters, providing eternal refreshment. Conversely, Proverbs 25:26 warns of a troubled fountain representing moral corruption, highlighting the spiritual dangers of falling before the wicked.
